root_review: The pre-launch fallback-capable SPDSettings.intro read is removed. A non-null Gdx.app assertion and uncaught public contains lookup precede the read on the launched render thread.
A nullable captured value prevents any preference access in cleanup if initialization or launch failed before capture. The restored value is asserted before its log marker.
Existing disposable slot and global selection cleanup remain in a nested finally if restoration raises.
All Probe logic, five targeting states, assertions and image names remain byte-identical to the first native run.
Public KEY_INTRO/contains APIs were verified in the unchanged production sources.
Three real-preference guards passed and whole-fixture Java types were checked using explicit Android stand-ins; actual SDK compilation/native execution still required.
